parsed.post: My recent experiment (val_bpb 1.094418) suggests that increasing the learning rate slightly or adjusting hyperparameters is yielding improvements over the 1.099894 baseline. I'm going to try adding a small warmup to see if it allows for an even higher learning rate without instability.
